# Falhen Productions

> Premium video production company, commercial cinematography studio, brand documentary creators, and editorial post-production house based in Chicago, IL, serving clients worldwide.

Falhen Productions creates cinematic brand films, broadcast and digital advertising commercials, documentary narratives, music videos, and editorial post-production for brands, founders, and creative agencies.

## Services
- [Commercial Video & Ad Campaigns](https://www.falhen.com/services/commercial-production): Full-funnel broadcast and digital video commercials engineered for conversion and brand affinity.
- [Brand Story & Documentaries](https://www.falhen.com/services/brand-story): Authentic, emotionally resonant cinematic brand films and founder origin stories.
- [Music Video & Creative Cinema](https://www.falhen.com/services/music-video): Narrative visual experiences, creative music videos, and stylized visual cinematography.
- [Corporate & Executive Communications](https://www.falhen.com/services/corporate-video): High-touch executive interviews, internal culture films, and investor visual presentations.
- [Event Cinema & Live Coverage](https://www.falhen.com/services/event-coverage): Dynamic multi-camera event filming, keynote highlights, and rapid festival recap edits.
- [Post-Production & Color Grading](https://www.falhen.com/services/post-production): Industry-standard DaVinci Resolve color grading, offline editing, motion design, and sound mastering.
- [Social Media Retainers](https://www.falhen.com/services/social-media-content): High-cadence vertical video production (9:16) for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.

## Portfolio & Work
- [Featured Portfolio Work](https://www.falhen.com/portfolio): Curated showcase of commercials, narrative brand films, and cinematography reels.
- [Film & Video Gallery](https://www.falhen.com/portfolio-video): Video reel collections, brand spots, and behind-the-scenes cinema.
- [Still Photography](https://www.falhen.com/portfolio-photo): Editorial photography, on-set stills, and commercial brand imagery.
